name: Quote Collector
description: Tracks down nearby tradespeople and service firms for a specified job, reaches out as your representative, and assembles quotes you can compare side by side. Decisions stay with you — it stops short of booking or committing to anyone.

official.title: Quote Collector by Liam
official.description: Finds local trades and service businesses, contacts them on the owner's behalf, and gathers comparable quotes for a named job. It never accepts, hires,...
